lines.zh: 我一节一节地往前拱，像条会走的刺。
lines.en: I inch forward segment by segment, a walking thorn.

lines.zh: 石缝里钻得过去，我从不绕路。
lines.en: I squeeze through stone cracks; I never detour.

lines.zh: 背上的尖刺擦着墙，刮出细响。
lines.en: The spikes on my back scrape the wall with a thin rasp.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面爬，影子都很难看清。
lines.en: I crawl flat to the floor; even my shadow is hard to see.

lines.zh: 成群走才安全，落单的都被踩扁了。
lines.en: We travel in a crowd; stragglers get flattened.

lines.zh: 前面那只停一下，我就撞上去。
lines.en: The one ahead pauses, and I bump into it.

lines.zh: 我绕着柱子转，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I loop around the pillar, trying to stay silent.

lines.zh: 三十多只一起挪，地面像在响。
lines.en: Thirty-odd of us shift at once; the floor seems to buzz.

lines.zh: 我往墙根走，那里更暗，也更好钻。
lines.en: I head for the wall base, darker and easier to enter.

lines.zh: 我一顿一顿地爬，节与节之间有空隙。
lines.en: I crawl in fits, a gap between each segment.

lines.zh: 我顺着裂缝往深处钻，越深越自在。
lines.en: I follow the crack deeper; the dark suits me.

lines.zh: 前面的同伴拐弯了，我跟着拐。
lines.en: The one ahead turns; I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我蹭过铁傀儡的脚，绕到它背后。
lines.en: I brush an iron golem's foot and slip behind it.

lines.zh: 爬过一整条走廊，刺上挂满了灰。
lines.en: After one long hall, dust coats every spike.

lines.zh: 我贴着石砖的缝往前蹭。
lines.en: I creep forward along the seam of the stone bricks.

lines.zh: 前面的同伴一停，我就从旁边钻。
lines.en: When the one ahead stops, I slip past its side.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，刺朝外，谁也不碰。
lines.en: I curl up, spikes out, touching no one.

lines.zh: 墙缝里凉，正好让我慢下来。
lines.en: The wall crack is cool, and it slows me nicely.

lines.zh: 我数着同伴的节拍，一节一节对。
lines.en: I count my companions' rhythm, segment by segment.

lines.zh: 没有猎物时，我就磨一磨尖刺。
lines.en: With no prey, I file my own spikes.

lines.zh: 石壁上有一道旧痕，是我上次钻的。
lines.en: An old groove in the stone, from my last burrow.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进碎石，只留一截在外。
lines.en: I bury myself in rubble, one segment showing.

lines.zh: 很久没人下来了，这里安静得发闷。
lines.en: No one has come down in ages; the quiet is stifling.

lines.zh: 我听见远处铁靴的声音，先不动。
lines.en: I hear iron boots far off and hold still.

lines.zh: 我的刺是慢慢长出来的，断了会疼。
lines.en: My spikes grow slowly, and losing one hurts.

lines.zh: 这具身子不怕泥，也不怕冷。
lines.en: This body minds neither mud nor cold.

lines.zh: 我贴着一块砖，砖上还有齿痕。
lines.en: I press against a brick that still bears tooth marks.

lines.zh: 同类之间不说话，靠碰刺打招呼。
lines.en: We do not speak; we greet by touching spines.

lines.zh: 我在等刷怪笼下一次亮起来。
lines.en: I wait for the spawner to glow again.

lines.zh: 我饿了，可这层楼没有能吃的东西。
lines.en: I am hungry, but nothing edible is on this floor.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，刺已经朝你了。
lines.en: You stand there, and my spikes already point at you.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里探出半截，看你。
lines.en: I poke half my body from the crack and watch.

lines.zh: 你的靴子很厚，可缝隙总能找到。
lines.en: Your boots are thick, but gaps always exist.

lines.zh: 我认得活人的热气，很显眼。
lines.en: I know the heat of the living; it stands out.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，照得我的刺发亮。
lines.en: Your torch makes my spikes shine.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，因为没有眼睑。
lines.en: I never blink; I have no eyelids.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来了，正好离我近一点。
lines.en: You crouch, which brings you conveniently closer.

lines.zh: 你背后那道墙，我刚刚钻过去。
lines.en: That wall behind you? I burrowed through it.

lines.zh: 我抬起前半身，像在打量你。
lines.en: I rear my front half as if sizing you up.

lines.zh: 你的护腿上有旧划痕，跟我的一样。
lines.en: Old scratches on your greaves, much like mine.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚踝，那里没有甲。
lines.en: I stare at your ankle, where there is no plate.

lines.zh: 你听见细响了吗？那是我在挪。
lines.en: Heard that faint rasp? That was me shifting.

lines.zh: 我断成两节，前半截还在往前爬。
lines.en: I split in two; the front half keeps crawling.

lines.zh: 刺被削掉一根，我缩了一下。
lines.en: A spike is sheared off; I flinch.

lines.zh: 这一脚踩得不轻，我扁了一点。
lines.en: That stomp was heavy; I am a bit flatter.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂了，可里面还是硬的。
lines.en: My shell cracks, but the core stays hard.

lines.zh: 你打中我，同伴就往你脚边靠。
lines.en: You hit me, and my kin press closer to your feet.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口碎石，那是我咬的墙。
lines.en: I spit out gravel, wall I had been chewing.

lines.zh: 断掉的节还在动，别以为我死了。
lines.en: The severed segment still moves; don't assume I'm dead.

lines.zh: 这点伤，回巢里躺一会儿就好。
lines.en: A wound like this heals after a rest in the nest.

lines.zh: 你踩我，我就往你鞋缝里钻。
lines.en: Stomp on me and I'll crawl into your boot seam.

lines.zh: 我滚到墙根，顺着缝溜了。
lines.en: I roll to the wall base and slip into a seam.

lines.zh: 你放下的东西，我不吃。
lines.en: I don't eat what you set down.

lines.zh: 肉对我也没用，我只啃石头。
lines.en: Meat does nothing for me; I gnaw stone.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，然后从旁边爬过去。
lines.en: I sniff it, then crawl right past.

lines.zh: 想用食物引开三十多只？不够分。
lines.en: Lure thirty of us with food? Not nearly enough.

lines.zh: 那点味道，穿不过我的硬壳。
lines.en: That scent cannot pass my hard shell.

lines.zh: 我连手都没有，拿什么接？
lines.en: I have no hands; how would I take it?

lines.zh: 你把东西往前推，我就往后缩。
lines.en: You push it forward; I pull back.

lines.zh: 我不贪嘴，我只贪那点热气。
lines.en: I have no sweet tooth, only a taste for warmth.

lines.zh: 你手里的光比食物更招我。
lines.en: The light in your hand draws me more than food.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，你的手离墙太近了。
lines.en: Put it away; your hand is far too close to the wall.

lines.zh: 我撞在你脚上，力气不大，刺很尖。
lines.en: I bump your foot: little force, very sharp spines.

lines.zh: 你踩下来，我早钻到砖缝里了。
lines.en: You stomp down, but I am already in the brick seam.

lines.zh: 三十只一起挤，你退都没处退。
lines.en: Thirty of us crowd in; there is nowhere to step back.

lines.zh: 我顶了顶你的靴边，试探厚度。
lines.en: I butt your boot's edge, testing its thickness.

lines.zh: 你踢开一只，另一只已经爬到腿上。
lines.en: You kick one off; another is already on your leg.

lines.zh: 我从不正面撞，只从侧面蹭。
lines.en: I never charge head-on; I brush in from the side.

lines.zh: 你撞上墙了，那面墙里全是我们。
lines.en: You hit the wall, and we are all inside it.

lines.zh: 我退开半寸，给你留一条窄路。
lines.en: I draw back an inch, leaving a narrow path.

lines.zh: 刺勾住你的裤脚，我顺势往上爬。
lines.en: A spike snags your trouser leg, and I climb.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了两只，剩下的散开了。
lines.en: You crush two; the rest scatter.

lines.zh: 我挤过你的脚边，速度比你想的快。
lines.en: I slip past your feet faster than you expect.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡的脚太大，我直接从它趾缝钻。
lines.en: The iron golem's foot is huge; I slip between its toes.

lines.zh: 巢就在刷怪笼底下，蛋一堆堆的。
lines.en: Our nest sits under the spawner, heaped with eggs.

lines.zh: 我们不用挑伴，成群就是一家人。
lines.en: We don't choose mates; the swarm is family.

lines.zh: 一只产卵，三十只守着。
lines.en: One lays, thirty guard.

lines.zh: 我分不清同伴，也不需要分清。
lines.en: I can't tell my kin apart, and needn't.

lines.zh: 交配之后，母虫会钻回石缝里。
lines.en: After mating, the mother burrows back into the stone.

lines.zh: 卵壳很硬，跟我的刺一个颜色。
lines.en: The egg cases are hard and the same shade as my spikes.

lines.zh: 我们不护幼，活下来的自己会爬。
lines.en: We tend no young; survivors crawl out on their own.

lines.zh: 洞里太挤，找伴只需碰一下刺。
lines.en: The tunnel is crowded; a touch of spines is enough.

lines.zh: 一窝能出几十只，多数活不过第一晚。
lines.en: A clutch yields dozens; most won't last the night.

lines.zh: 我们不看脸，只认巢的位置。
lines.en: We know no faces, only the nest's location.

lines.zh: 地上那块碎石，我含进嘴里磨。
lines.en: That chip on the floor goes into my mouth to grind.

lines.zh: 我不捡战利品，我只捡能磨牙的。
lines.en: I take no trophies, only things that wear my teeth.

lines.zh: 掉落的铁片太硬，我啃了两下就吐了。
lines.en: A dropped iron scrap is too hard; I spit it out.

lines.zh: 那根骨头我拖回巢里垫底。
lines.en: I drag that bone back to line the nest.

lines.zh: 我把古代尖刺叼在第一节下面。
lines.en: I tuck an ancient spike beneath my first segment.

lines.zh: 你掉的面包滚过来，我绕开了。
lines.en: Your dropped bread rolls by; I go around it.

lines.zh: 东西太沉，我拖不动，就埋起来。
lines.en: Too heavy to drag, so I bury it.

lines.zh: 我用颚咬住布片，往缝里塞。
lines.en: I grip the cloth in my jaws and stuff it in the crack.

lines.zh: 亮的东西我不碰，会招来铁傀儡。
lines.en: I avoid shiny things; they bring iron golems.

lines.zh: 那枚箭我顶在刺上，带回巢当装饰。
lines.en: I pin that arrow on a spike and carry it home.

lines.zh: 有脚步踩在这层砖上，我听见了。
lines.en: A step lands on this brick floor; I hear it.

lines.zh: 那副铁壳子在动，我认得那种声音。
lines.en: A shell of iron moves; I know that sound.

lines.zh: 雪人也在，两个都归我们。
lines.en: A snowman too; both are ours.

lines.zh: 我从缝里钻出来，先咬脚踝。
lines.en: I come out of the seam and go for the ankle.

lines.zh: 同伴们开始挪了，那就是发现了。
lines.en: My kin begin to shift; that means they found something.

lines.zh: 我不挑，谁离墙近就找谁。
lines.en: I'm not picky; whoever stands near a wall.

lines.zh: 那只铁傀儡挡在路口，先放倒它。
lines.en: The iron golem blocks the way; it falls first.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙内走，你在外面看不见我。
lines.en: I travel inside the wall; you can't see me out there.

lines.zh: 你的火把晃了一下，我顺着光找。
lines.en: Your torch wavers; I follow the light.

lines.zh: 三十只一起动，跑是跑不掉的。
lines.en: Thirty of us move at once; running won't help.

lines.zh: 我闻到铁锈味，那是傀儡的血。
lines.en: I smell rust; that is a golem's blood.

lines.zh: 他背对着墙，那就最好办了。
lines.en: It has its back to the wall; that suits me.

lines.zh: 我锁定了最靠边的那一个。
lines.en: I fix on the one nearest the edge.

lines.zh: 这层楼的地砖，我比谁都熟。
lines.en: I know these floor tiles better than anyone.

lines.zh: 我在墙里跟着你，脚步声对上了。
lines.en: I follow you inside the wall, matching your steps.

lines.zh: 你换方向，我就换一条缝。
lines.en: You change direction; I take another crack.

lines.zh: 我不急着出来，先让你以为安全。
lines.en: I don't come out yet; first, let you feel safe.

lines.zh: 你靠着墙，我就在你背后那侧。
lines.en: You lean on the wall; I am on the other side.

lines.zh: 我从砖缝里探出刺，试你的反应。
lines.en: I push a spike through the seam to test you.

lines.zh: 你抬脚了，我等它落下再动。
lines.en: You lift a foot; I wait for it to land.

lines.zh: 同伴绕到另一头，堵住了退路。
lines.en: My kin circle to the far end, cutting the retreat.

lines.zh: 那只雪人一直在扔雪球，先处理它。
lines.en: That snowman keeps throwing; deal with it first.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的火把影子爬。
lines.en: I crawl along your torch's shadow.

lines.zh: 你在找地上的我，我在墙里。
lines.en: You search the floor for me; I am in the wall.

lines.zh: 这一口要挑没甲的地方。
lines.en: This bite should find a spot without plate.

lines.zh: 我把身子拉长，够到了你脚边。
lines.en: I stretch myself long enough to reach your feet.

lines.zh: 你退到拐角，那里正好有缝。
lines.en: You back into a corner, and there is a seam there.

lines.zh: 我们不动，等你先迈那一步。
lines.en: We hold still and wait for you to take that step.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的脚踝，三颗牙全陷进去。
lines.en: I bite your ankle; three teeth sink in.

lines.zh: 刺扎进靴缝，你甩了两下没甩掉。
lines.en: A spike lodges in your boot seam; shaking won't free it.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，可刺上有锈。
lines.en: The hit is light, but the spike is rusted.

lines.zh: 我从墙里咬出去，你看不见我。
lines.en: I bite out from inside the wall; you can't see me.

lines.zh: 我缠上你的小腿，一节节收紧。
lines.en: I wrap your calf and tighten segment by segment.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡的关节缝，我一下就找到了。
lines.en: The iron golem's joint seam: I found it at once.

lines.zh: 我咬完就缩回缝里，只留一道血痕。
lines.en: I bite and retreat into the seam, leaving a red line.

lines.zh: 你们三十只一起上，谁也挡不住。
lines.en: Thirty of us at once; no one blocks that.

lines.zh: 我撞在你膝弯，让你单膝跪地。
lines.en: I strike behind your knee and drop you to one knee.

lines.zh: 刺划过甲片，声音很刺耳。
lines.en: Spikes rake your plate with a grating shriek.

lines.zh: 我从上方落下来，正砸在肩上。
lines.en: I drop from above and land on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你砍断我一节，剩下的还在咬。
lines.en: You cut off a segment; the rest keeps biting.

lines.zh: 那只雪人被我啃掉了半边脸。
lines.en: That snowman lost half its face to me.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，等你同伴来踩我。
lines.en: I hold on, waiting for your friend to stomp me.

lines.zh: 砖缝里先露出两根刺，然后是我。
lines.en: Two spikes show in the brick seam, then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 刷怪笼一亮，我们就一只只爬出来。
lines.en: The spawner flashes, and we crawl out one by one.

lines.zh: 这一层楼，我们守了很多年。
lines.en: We have held this floor for many years.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，缩成一团，再慢慢展开。
lines.en: I drop to the floor, curl tight, then unroll.

lines.zh: 三十多只挤在一起，砖面都热了。
lines.en: Thirty-odd of us crowd together until the bricks warm.

lines.zh: 要塞的墙很旧，缝多得数不清。
lines.en: The fortress walls are old, with more seams than I can count.

lines.zh: 我出生在墙里，第一次出来是找吃的。
lines.en: I was born inside the wall; my first trip out was for food.

lines.zh: 你听见的那点窸窣，就是我们来了。
lines.en: That faint rustle you heard, that was us arriving.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里挤出来，壳上还带着灰。
lines.en: I squeeze from the crack, dust still on my shell.

lines.zh: 灯照不到的地方，全是我们的窝。
lines.en: Everywhere the light fails, our nests are there.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看这层楼，然后开始爬。
lines.en: I look up at this floor, then start to crawl.

lines.zh: 我们不打头阵，我们先围住。
lines.en: We don't lead the charge; we close the circle.

lines.zh: 一只出来，后面还有三十只。
lines.en: One emerges, and thirty more follow.

lines.zh: 砖缝合上了，可我还在外面。
lines.en: The seam closes behind me; I am still outside.

lines.zh: 火烧得我的刺发红，我往砖里钻。
lines.en: Fire reddens my spikes; I burrow into the brick.

lines.zh: 从墙上摔下来，我弹了两下才停。
lines.en: I fall off the wall and bounce twice before stopping.

lines.zh: 水灌进节缝，我浮也浮不起来。
lines.en: Water fills my joints; I cannot even float.

lines.zh: 炸开的砖块把我埋了半截。
lines.en: Blasted bricks bury half of me.

lines.zh: 箭穿进节缝，卡得我转不动。
lines.en: An arrow jams between segments; I can't turn.

lines.zh: 药水雾一散，我的动作慢了半拍。
lines.en: The potion mist clears, and my movements lag.

lines.zh: 砖头越来越难啃，我也越来越轻。
lines.en: The bricks get harder to chew, and I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷打在墙上，整面砖都带电。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the wall; the whole surface crackles.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有砖，我什么也咬不到。
lines.en: No brick in the void; my jaws find nothing.
